na5733328bf.headline: Supply Ministry announces increase in oil price on ration card: one-liter bottle at 21 pounds
na5733328bf.summary: The Egyptian Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade announced a price increase for cooking oil on ration cards to 21 pounds per liter.
na5733328bf.why: Price changes in staple goods affect inflation and consumer spending in Egypt's economy.
